notes.title: Demo Incoming: Black Paradox Reloaded Lands on December 3rd!
notes.notes:
Hello, bounty hunters! 🚀

Over the past few months, we got a bit sidetracked trying to find a publisher to help us with the game's marketing. After several attempts (and quite a bit of time wasted), we decided to move forward on our own and refocus not only on development but also on communicating directly with you about the game.

[h3][b]The demo is almost ready and will be available on December 3rd![/b][/h3] It includes the first two levels of the game and will let you try out all the different weapons, upgrades, and power-ups that will be featured in the full version.

[previewyoutube=DBSvWDSLIhA;full][/previewyoutube]

In the demo, you'll also find an option to leave your feedback. Please do so! Your input is incredibly valuable to help us ensure we're heading in the right direction and to adjust things based on what you want to see.

If you can’t wait until December 3rd, you can sign up for our mailing list to join a beta testing phase for the demo: subscribepage.io/GEtgKa


As for the full game, we’ve finished the reskin and are now focused on improving game balance and polishing the remaining boss fights.

We’re aiming to release the full game in early 2025.

That’s all for now.

Catch you next time!

notes.title: Exclusive Demo Day Approaches with Exciting New Features!
notes.notes:
Hello Bounty Hunters,

We’ve got some awesome updates on our game development. Things are on track, and we’ve just wrapped up a demo that lets you dive into the first two levels, complete with epic boss battles.

The demo drops in a few weeks, and [url=https://subscribepage.io/GEtgKa]you can be the first to try it out by signing up for our newsletter.[/url]

Here’s What You Can Expect:

The demo kicks off with a cool illustrated intro to set the scene. 

[previewyoutube=ONppTCkOIZg;full][/previewyoutube]
Each level starts with a map showing your progress and teasing the boss waiting for you at the end. It's a neat way to see how far you've come and what’s next.
As you play, you’ll find new weapons to collect by taking down special cargo ships. These weapons add some fun variety and strategy to your loadout.

[previewyoutube=eu13jD-CDKw;full][/previewyoutube]
At the end of each level, you'll face off against a boss from the Hellraiser gang. These fights are introduced with a quick animated sequence, adding some story flavor. After you beat the boss, you get to pick one of two upgrades for your vehicle—either a companion drone to boost your firepower or a special ability to enhance your stats. It’s all about choosing what suits your playstyle best.

[previewyoutube=sXB0o8f9p3I;full][/previewyoutube]
Each level has a unique look, thanks to our amazing artist. The second level, for example, features a stunning background that really sets the scene.

[previewyoutube=dxbDv4Kg8I8;full][/previewyoutube]
The demo wraps up with a showdown against the second boss—a space cowboy alien with magical powers. This guy can multiply and disappear, making for a challenging and memorable fight.

[previewyoutube=CkqJVYFF-8g;full][/previewyoutube]
We’re excited for you to try out these new features and can’t wait to hear what you think.

Stay tuned for more updates!
See you in the next devlog!

notes.title: Progress Update & Beta Testing Sign-Up
notes.notes:
Hello Bounty Hunters,

We aim to keep you updated on our progress by posting a devlog every two weeks.

Development is going smoothly, and we are on track to complete the project by October.

We are wrapping up the development of the first two game levels, which will be included in a demo for the beta testing session. This demo will also feature the garage section, where you can enhance your vehicle's stats by purchasing chips that modify your machine.
Various in-game power-ups will be available, including drones, special abilities, and different types of weapons.

We hope you enjoy it and look forward to your feedback. 
[h2][url=https://subscribepage.io/GEtgKa]Sign up for beta testing here![/url] [/h2]

We are putting significant effort into the new game graphics. Here you can see a comparison between some elements of the original game and the reloaded version.

notes.title: BLACK PARADOX RELOADED
notes.notes:
To celebrate the fifth anniversary of the release of Black Paradox, we are excited to announce a remastered and enhanced version: Black Paradox Reloaded. Thanks to the valuable feedback from our community of players, we have worked hard to enrich the gaming experience graphically and in terms of gameplay.

[previewyoutube=BpgfHFca22w;full][/previewyoutube]

The game will feature two new game modes in addition to the classic story mode: Arcade and Boss Rush. You can also play local co-op with a friend, making the experience even more engaging.

The official Steam release is scheduled for October, with console and mobile versions to follow later.

The Steam page is now live, and you can add the game to your wishlist to stay updated on the latest news and releases.

We invite all enthusiasts to try the beta version of the game by [url=subscribepage.io/GEtgKa]signing up for our mailing list[/url].

Get ready to enter the cockpit, arm your weapons, and prepare for the ultimate galactic showdown!
